subgroups.title: Black Belt Capstone Project
subgroups.introduction: Watch this video to learn about the Black Belt Capstone project process!

attributes.description: Welcome to Black Belt! In this Capstone project, you’ll apply your previous learning by creating your own advanced, creative project in JavaScript. This level looks a little bit different! There are no Build, Explore, Solve, or Quest activities; only a Capstone project for you to complete! Select the achievement below, then click “Prove Yourself” and follow the directions to get started!

badges.title: Something to be Proud Of
badges.description: Use everything you’ve learned throughout IMPACT to create your own advanced, creative project!
